test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Ritu is a __diligent__ girl who looks after her aged parents.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Hardworking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"diligent"** means showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties. (परिश्रमी, मेहनती)

 
 
• **Example:** The diligent student spent hours preparing for her exams and achieved excellent results.
 
 
 
• **"Hardworking"** refers to putting in a lot of effort and dedication into tasks or responsibilities. (कड़ी मेहनत करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The team was so hardworking that they completed the project well before the deadline.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for **"diligent"** is **"hardworking."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Hardworking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stupid** (मूर्ख): Lacking intelligence or common sense.

 
 
• **Example:** It was a stupid mistake to leave the keys in the car.
 
 
 
• **Lethargic** (सुस्त): Lacking energy or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** After the long journey, she felt lethargic and needed rest.
 
 
 
• **Innocent** (निर्दोष): Free from guilt or wrongdoing; naive or pure.
 
 
• **Example:** The child gave an innocent smile that melted everyone's heart.
